title: Of all the mammals on Earth, by weight, what share is wild?
subtitle: Weigh every mammal on Earth and guess the wild slice, then meet the dogs, pigs and chickens that outweigh whole kingdoms of wildlife.
form: ask on pie slice (drag the edge)
notes: OWID (Greenspoon et al. 2023) gives wild 5 % (2 land + 3 marine), humans 36 %, livestock 59 % - brief had 4/34/62. Review round 2026-10-07: two voices (b guesses half, jokes about the tug of war with cows, guesses pigs vs whales); the guess pie is two-way (Us + our animals / Wild), so nothing leaks; pie fills the left 60 % (long slice labels shrank it to a dot; an explicit {x,y,w,h} box and a short label fixed it); opening icons (cow, person, whale) come back beside the shares; new twist line: poultry are 71 % of bird weight (same OWID page). Left: no way to explode a slice, so the 5 % is a large red label instead.
